entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-29
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Follow ups for file-based programs source package #51487
  • Remove CA2226 rule? #51484
  • 2xx build needs to download workload packages #51482
  • `dotnet test` should respect platform #51481
  • [Hot Reload][Unstable] Some warnings "Expected to find a static method 'ClearCache', 'UpdateApplication' or 'UpdateContent'..." appear after saving the code snippets changes in .cs/.razor files of Windows Forms/WPF App in dotnet watch #51480

Closed

  • [.NET10RC2] `dotnet watch run --no-hot-reload` fails #51476
  • Property parsing splits up -p properties into more tokens and breaks `dotnet test` #50923
    10.0.1xx

Created

  • Sign `Microsoft.Installation` library package #51488

Merged

  • Add analyzer CA1517: Prefer ReadOnlySpan #51216

Updated
